Looking for a porta cabin in Lucknow? SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures steel porta cabins and ships them ready-to-use to sites across Lucknow from our Greater Noida factory. The road distance is about 500 km, so a finished unit usually reaches your site in 2 to 3 working days. You get a single-room steel cabin — site office, security post, rest room, or store — built to size, wired, and finished before it leaves the factory. No on-site construction, no waiting for masonry to cure.

SAMAN has been making prefab steel structures since 2009 and runs two factories — Greater Noida for North India and Bangalore for the South. Lucknow is served fully from our Greater Noida plant. As a porta cabin manufacturer we control the steel, the panels, and the finish in-house, so what we quote is what we build.

Why buyers in Lucknow choose SAMAN

Lucknow is Uttar Pradesh's capital and a fast-growing administrative, commercial, and construction hub. The government and infrastructure projects, the new townships along the Shaheed Path and the outer ring road, the IT and warehousing growth, and the steady institutional building work all need quick, movable workspace. A porta cabin gives you that without tying up land or building a permanent structure for a temporary need.

We build to order, not from stock. Your cabin is sized for your site, finished in the colour you want, and fitted with the electrical points and windows you actually need. If you want to compare builds first, see our porta cabin lineup with full specs and photos. SAMAN holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certification, with 500+ projects delivered across India.

Local uses for porta cabins in Lucknow

Lucknow's demand spreads across its construction corridors and industrial areas:

  • Amausi / Scooter India industrial belt and the Transport Nagar area — manufacturing and logistics units use porta cabins as supervisor offices and store rooms.
  • Shaheed Path and outer ring road townships (226002 / 226010) — developers use them as site offices, sales cabins, and security posts during construction.
  • Government and infrastructure projects across the city — contractors use them as on-site project offices that move with the work.
  • Warehousing on the Kanpur Road and Sultanpur Road corridors — operators use them as gate and weighbridge cabins.

For any site from Amausi to Gomti Nagar Extension, a single truck delivers and places the cabin in a day.

Specifications and sizes

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built on a welded MS steel frame using IS 2062 grade hollow sections. The standard build:

  • Frame: mild steel hollow section, welded and anti-rust treated
  • Wall panels: PUF insulated sandwich panel or cement fibre board — PUF helps against Lucknow's hot summers and cold winters
  • Roof: GI sheet or colour-coated profile sheet with slope for rain runoff
  • Flooring: marine ply, cement board, or vinyl over a steel base
  • Doors and windows: powder-coated steel or aluminium, positioned to your layout

Sizes run from a compact 6×8 ft security cabin up to 20×8 ft and 40×8 ft office units, with multi-room layouts available. For full construction detail and finish options, see the MS porta cabin product page — the build most Lucknow site offices use. Any size in between is made to order.

Customisation options

Tell us how the cabin will be used and we build around it:

  • Split AC points and extra power sockets — useful through the Lucknow summer
  • Internal partitions for a separate cabin or meeting room
  • Toilet and washbasin block built into the unit
  • Extra windows or a glass front for a reception or sales cabin
  • Loft storage above the ceiling line
  • Anti-skid flooring for workshop or wet areas

Price guidance

A porta cabin price in Lucknow depends on the size, the wall panel you choose (cement board is economical, PUF panel costs more but insulates better), the interior fit-out, and the transport distance to your exact site. Because every unit is made to order, we confirm a firm price at quotation once we know your size and use — no hidden add-ons after.

Delivery and installation to Lucknow

Your cabin is built and finished at our Greater Noida factory, then trucked to Lucknow on the Agra–Lucknow Expressway / NH-27 route — typically 2 to 3 working days from dispatch. Smaller units arrive fully assembled and are craned into position in a few hours. Larger or multi-room units arrive in sections and are bolted together on site by our team. You need a level base — a plinth, a concrete pad, or compacted ground — ready before delivery.

We deliver across North India and the NCR belt from the same factory. If you are comparing options for a nearby site, you can also see our portable cabins in Faridabad and portable cabins in Ghaziabad pages.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a porta cabin cost in Lucknow?

The price depends on size, panel type, and fit-out. A small security cabin costs far less than a fully fitted office unit. We confirm the exact figure at quotation once we know your requirement.

How long does delivery to Lucknow take?

Usually 2 to 3 working days from dispatch out of our Greater Noida factory, since the road distance is about 500 km on the expressway.

Do you deliver across Uttar Pradesh from Lucknow?

Yes. We serve Lucknow and the wider UP belt from our Greater Noida factory, with delivery timed to the site distance.

Can the porta cabin be moved later?

Yes. It is a bolted steel structure — it can be lifted, loaded, and relocated when your site work moves.

What sizes are available?

From a 6×8 ft single cabin up to 40×8 ft office units and larger multi-room layouts, all made to order.

Get a quote for your porta cabin in Lucknow

Tell us your size, use, and site location and we will send a clear quote. For North India and the NCR, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or send an enquiry through the form and our team will get back to you.
